name: lightbox
title: Lightbox
description: A picture opened large over the page, in a native dialog.
use: A thumbnail, a figure or a screenshot a reader may want to see large. The thumbnail's own button opens the dialog with commandfor and command="show-modal"; closedby="any" lets a click outside the picture close it. Set --lightbox-ratio to the picture's proportions.

instead.when: The overlay holds a title, text or a form
The picture stays in the page with its caption
Two versions of one picture are compared

keyboard.action: Closes the lightbox and returns focus to the button that opened it

platform.feature: commandfor with command="show-modal" and command="close" (invoker commands)
platform.fallback: Call dialog.showModal() and dialog.close() from a click handler; the stylesheet is the same
A click outside the picture does nothing; Escape and the close button still close it
The picture and the scrim appear and leave at once, without the fade

classes.name: lightbox
classes.description: The dialog, with no sheet of its own: it is exactly as large as the picture, over a dimmed and blurred page

classes.name: lightbox-media
classes.description: The picture, a video or a frame: 64rem wide or as large as the viewport allows with a 24px gutter, at the proportions of --lightbox-ratio

classes.name: lightbox-caption
classes.description: A floating bar under the picture, as wide as it is

classes.name: lightbox-close
classes.description: On the close button: it rests 8px inside the top corner of the picture

states.name: open
states.description: Set by the browser when the dialog is shown. Do not write it in markup: a dialog that starts with open is not modal

properties.name: --lightbox-ratio
properties.description: The picture's proportions, width over height; the picture is cropped to them

properties.name: --lightbox-gutter
properties.description: The room kept between the picture and each edge of the viewport
